signals.name: No Access Policy
signals.description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are not defined in policy.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify systems where access control policies are absent, not documented, or not enforced, including lack of formal authorization procedures, missing implementation of least privilege principles, inadequate separation of duties, or absence of regular access reviews and recertification processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Identity Assertion Protection
signals.description: Identity assertions are not protected, conveyed, and verified.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify authentication flows where identity assertions (such as tokens, tickets, or SAML assertions) lack cryptographic protection during transmission, are conveyed over insecure channels, or are not properly validated by relying parties before granting access.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Authentication
signals.description: Users, services, and hardware are not authenticated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify systems and services that lack authentication mechanisms or allow unauthenticated access to resources, including missing authentication requirements for users, service accounts, APIs, and hardware devices before granting access to systems or data.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Identity Management
signals.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are not managed.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify systems and environments where identity lifecycle management processes are absent or inadequate, including lack of credential provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning procedures for users, services, and hardware devices.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Identity Proofing
signals.description: Identities are not proofed and bound to credentials based on context.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify authentication systems where identity verification processes are missing or insufficient, including lack of identity proofing procedures that validate user claims before credential issuance and inadequate binding of verified identities to authentication credentials based on risk context.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Physical Access Controls
signals.description: Physical access to assets is not managed, monitored, and enforced.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify facilities, data centers, and equipment locations where physical access controls are absent or inadequate, including lack of access management procedures, missing monitoring capabilities (such as surveillance or access logs), or insufficient enforcement mechanisms relative to the criticality and sensitivity of assets.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Adverse Event Analysis
signals.description: Potentially adverse events are not analyzed to understand associated activities.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should perform detailed analysis of detected potentially adverse events to understand the full scope of related activities, attack patterns, affected systems, timelines, and potential indicators of compromise. This analysis helps distinguish true security incidents from false positives and enables effective response planning.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Impact and Scope Understanding
signals.description: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are not understood.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should assess and document the estimated impact of adverse events on business operations, data confidentiality, system integrity, and service availability. Understanding the scope includes identifying all affected systems, users, data assets, and business processes to enable appropriate prioritization and response actions.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Incident Declaration Process
signals.description: Incidents are not declared when adverse events meet defined criteria.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should establish clear criteria for when adverse events are escalated to formal incident status and implement processes to ensure timely incident declaration. This includes defining severity thresholds, impact criteria, and authorization procedures that trigger the transition from event detection to incident response activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Information Correlation
signals.description: Information from multiple sources is not correlated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should correlate security events, alerts, and data from multiple sources such as network monitoring tools, endpoint detection systems, authentication logs, threat intelligence feeds, and physical security systems. This correlation enables detection of complex, multi-stage attacks and provides comprehensive visibility into potential security incidents.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Information Sharing on Adverse Events
signals.canonical_name: No Information Sharing on Adverse Events
signals.description: Information on adverse events is not provided to authorized staff and tools.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should establish processes to share relevant information about adverse events with appropriate internal stakeholders (security teams, incident responders, management) and automated security tools (SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms). This sharing should follow established authorization protocols and enable coordinated detection and response activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Threat Intelligence Integration
signals.description: Cyber threat intelligence is not integrated into the analysis.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should integrate cyber threat intelligence from internal and external sources, including threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), indicators of compromise (IOCs), vulnerability information, and industry-specific threat data. This contextual information enhances the analysis of adverse events and improves detection accuracy and response effectiveness.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Assets Not Prioritized Based on Criticality and Impact
signals.canonical_name: Assets Not Prioritized Based on Criticality and Impact
signals.description: Assets are not prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and mission impact.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of asset classification schemes, missing criticality ratings, lack of business impact assessments, or gaps in asset prioritization frameworks. Organizations should implement risk-based prioritization that considers data sensitivity, business criticality, regulatory requirements, and operational dependencies.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Data and Metadata Inventory Maintained
signals.canonical_name: No Data and Metadata Inventory Maintained
signals.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata are not maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of data catalogs, missing data classification inventories, lack of metadata management, or gaps in data asset documentation. Organizations should maintain comprehensive inventories that include sensitive data locations, data types, data owners, retention requirements, and processing activities for compliance with privacy and data protection regulations.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Hardware Inventory Maintained
signals.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are not maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of hardware inventory systems, missing CMDB entries for physical devices, lack of asset tracking processes, or gaps in hardware asset documentation. Organizations should maintain comprehensive inventories that include physical devices, networking equipment, servers, workstations, mobile devices, and IoT devices.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Systems and Assets Not Managed Throughout Life Cycles
signals.canonical_name: Systems and Assets Not Managed Throughout Life Cycles
signals.description: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are not managed throughout their life cycles.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of lifecycle management processes, missing decommissioning procedures, lack of secure disposal practices, or gaps in cradle-to-grave asset tracking. Organizations should implement lifecycle management that includes acquisition, deployment, maintenance, retirement, and secure disposal phases with appropriate security controls at each stage.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Network Communication and Data Flows Documented
signals.canonical_name: No Network Communication and Data Flows Documented
signals.description: Representations of authorized network communication and data flows are not maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of network diagrams, missing data flow documentation, lack of network segmentation maps, or gaps in traffic pattern documentation. Organizations should maintain current representations including network topology diagrams, data flow diagrams, firewall rulesets, API communications, and third-party data exchanges.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Software Inventory Maintained
signals.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are not maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of software inventory management tools, missing application catalogs, lack of license tracking, or gaps in software asset documentation. Organizations should maintain comprehensive inventories that include operating systems, applications, cloud services, SaaS platforms, databases, and middleware components.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Supplier Services Inventory Maintained
signals.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are not maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of vendor/supplier registries, missing third-party service catalogs, lack of supply chain documentation, or gaps in external service provider tracking. Organizations should maintain comprehensive inventories that include cloud service providers, managed service providers, contractors, outsourced services, and critical suppliers.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Data and Metadata Not Collected and Preserved
signals.canonical_name: Incident Data and Metadata Not Collected and Preserved
signals.description: Incident data and metadata are not collected and preserved.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incidents where logs, memory dumps, disk images, network captures, or system snapshots were not preserved. Monitor for missing metadata such as timestamps, user contexts, network flow information, or file hashes. Look for evidence spoliation risks from premature system restoration, log rotation, or backup overwrites before forensic data collection.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Actions Performed During Investigation Not Recorded
signals.canonical_name: Actions Performed During Investigation Not Recorded
signals.description: Actions performed during an investigation are not recorded.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for investigation activities without audit trails, missing chain of custody documentation, unlogged forensic tool usage, or analyst actions not captured in incident tracking systems. Monitor for lack of timestamped entries, missing digital signatures on evidence collection, or investigation steps performed outside documented procedures without record retention.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Magnitude Not Estimated and Validated
signals.canonical_name: Incident Magnitude Not Estimated and Validated
signals.description: An incident's magnitude is not estimated and validated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for incidents lacking scope assessments (number of affected systems, users, records), missing impact quantification (financial loss, downtime duration, data volume), or unvalidated initial estimations. Monitor for incidents closed without confirming the breadth of compromise, missing business impact analysis, or discrepancies between initial and final scope without documented validation processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Analysis Not Performed to Establish What Took Place and Root Cause
signals.canonical_name: Analysis Not Performed to Establish What Took Place and Root Cause
signals.description: Analysis is not performed to establish what has taken place and the root cause.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incidents closed without root cause analysis documentation, missing timeline reconstruction, incomplete attack chain mapping, or incidents lacking determination of initial attack vector. Monitor for cases where remediation occurs without understanding underlying vulnerabilities or configuration weaknesses that enabled the incident.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No General Cybersecurity Awareness
signals.description: Personnel are not provided with awareness and training for general tasks.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations or departments where general cybersecurity awareness programs are absent, including lack of security training for all personnel on common threats (phishing, social engineering, password security), missing onboarding security education, or no regular awareness campaigns to reinforce secure behaviors.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Specialized Role Training
signals.description: Individuals in specialized roles are not provided with awareness and training.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify gaps in role-specific security training for personnel with specialized responsibilities, including system administrators, developers, security operations staff, privacy officers, and other roles requiring advanced security knowledge, where targeted training programs on role-specific threats, secure practices, and compliance requirements are missing or inadequate.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Computing Hardware and Software Monitoring
signals.canonical_name: No Computing Hardware and Software Monitoring
signals.description: Computing hardware and software are not monitored for potentially adverse events.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should monitor endpoints, servers, workstations, mobile devices, containers, virtual machines, and their associated software and runtime environments. This includes monitoring for malware, unauthorized changes, configuration drift, vulnerability exploitation, resource consumption anomalies, and data integrity issues that could indicate potentially adverse events.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Network Monitoring
signals.description: Networks and network services are not monitored for potentially adverse events.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should implement continuous monitoring of network traffic, network services (DNS, DHCP, etc.), and network infrastructure to detect anomalies, unauthorized access attempts, malicious traffic patterns, and other potentially adverse events. This includes monitoring both internal and external network boundaries.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Personnel Activity Monitoring
signals.description: Personnel activity and technology usage are not monitored for potentially adverse events.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should monitor user activities, authentication events, privileged access usage, data access patterns, and technology usage to detect insider threats, compromised accounts, policy violations, or other potentially adverse events. This includes monitoring for anomalous behavior patterns and unauthorized activities while respecting privacy considerations.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Physical Environment Monitoring
signals.description: The physical environment is not monitored for potentially adverse events.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should implement monitoring of physical facilities, data centers, and other critical areas using surveillance systems, access logs, environmental sensors, and alarm systems to detect unauthorized physical access, environmental hazards, or other potentially adverse physical events that could impact information assets.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No External Service Provider Monitoring
signals.description: External service provider activities are not monitored for potentially adverse events.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should monitor activities of cloud service providers, managed service providers, vendors, and other third parties with access to systems or data. This includes reviewing service provider logs, monitoring API usage, tracking data transfers, and validating compliance with security requirements to detect potentially adverse events originating from or affecting external service providers.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Information Not Shared with Designated Stakeholders
signals.canonical_name: Information Not Shared with Designated Stakeholders
signals.description: Information is not shared with designated internal and external stakeholders.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for incidents where threat intelligence, indicators of compromise, or lessons learned were not shared with ISACs, peer organizations, or internal security teams. Monitor for missing contributions to threat sharing platforms, lack of post-incident reports to stakeholders, or incidents not communicated to affected business units or service providers who could benefit from the information.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Internal and External Stakeholders Not Notified of Incidents
signals.canonical_name: Internal and External Stakeholders Not Notified of Incidents
signals.description: Internal and external stakeholders are not notified of incidents.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for incidents affecting stakeholders without corresponding notification records, missing breach notifications to regulatory bodies within required timeframes, lack of customer communications for data breaches, or internal incidents not reported to executive management or board. Check for gaps in notification logs, missed SLA requirements for stakeholder updates, or incidents closed without stakeholder notification documentation.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Backups Not Protected
signals.description: Backups of data are not created, protected, maintained, and tested.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for missing backup schedules, unencrypted backups, lack of backup testing procedures, inadequate backup retention policies, failure to verify backup integrity, and absence of secure backup storage locations.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Data at Rest Not Protected
signals.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are not protected.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for unencrypted data storage, missing encryption controls, inadequate access controls on stored data, lack of integrity verification mechanisms, and insufficient availability protections for data at rest.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Data in Transit Not Protected
signals.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are not protected.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for unencrypted network communications, weak TLS/SSL configurations, lack of VPN usage for sensitive data transmission, missing integrity checks during data transfer, and inadequate protection of data during network transmission.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Data in Use Not Protected
signals.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are not protected.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of memory encryption, inadequate process isolation, missing secure enclaves or trusted execution environments, unprotected data in RAM, and insufficient controls to protect data during active processing and computation.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Improvements Not Identified from Evaluations
signals.description: Improvements are not identified from evaluations.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of formal evaluation processes, lack of documented improvements following assessments, or failure to implement feedback loops from security evaluations and audits.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Improvements Not Identified from Operational Execution
signals.canonical_name: Improvements Not Identified from Operational Execution
signals.description: Improvements are not identified from execution of operational processes.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of operational metrics review, absence of process improvement initiatives, failure to document operational inefficiencies or gaps, or missing feedback mechanisms from day-to-day security operations teams.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Response Plans and Cybersecurity Plans Not Maintained
signals.canonical_name: Incident Response Plans and Cybersecurity Plans Not Maintained
signals.description: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans are not established and maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for outdated or non-existent incident response plans, lack of plan distribution to relevant stakeholders, missing regular plan reviews and updates, or absence of plan testing and improvement cycles based on lessons learned.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Improvements Not Identified from Security Tests and Exercises
signals.canonical_name: Improvements Not Identified from Security Tests and Exercises
signals.description: Improvements are not identified from security tests and exercises.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of post-exercise analysis, lack of documented findings from penetration tests or tabletop exercises, failure to capture lessons learned from supplier security assessments, or missing action items following security testing activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Resource Capacity Not Maintained
signals.description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is not maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of capacity planning, insufficient resource monitoring, missing scalability mechanisms, inadequate performance baselines, failure to maintain resource reserves, and absence of capacity forecasting processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Technology Assets Not Protected from Environmental Threats
signals.canonical_name: Technology Assets Not Protected from Environmental Threats
signals.description: Technology assets are not protected from environmental threats.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of physical security controls, inadequate climate control systems, missing fire suppression, absence of power protection (UPS/generators), flood risk mitigation gaps, and insufficient protection against natural disasters and environmental hazards.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Networks Not Protected from Unauthorized Access
signals.canonical_name: Networks Not Protected from Unauthorized Access
signals.description: Networks and environments are not protected from unauthorized logical access.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for missing network segmentation, inadequate firewall rules, lack of network access controls, absence of intrusion prevention systems, weak authentication for network resources, and insufficient protection against unauthorized network access.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Resilience Mechanisms Not Implemented
signals.description: Mechanisms to achieve resilience requirements are not implemented.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of redundancy mechanisms, missing failover capabilities, absence of disaster recovery plans, inadequate business continuity measures, failure to implement high availability solutions, and insufficient resilience testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incidents Not Categorized and Prioritized
signals.description: Incidents are not categorized and prioritized.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for incidents missing category assignments (e.g., malware, phishing, data breach, unauthorized access) or priority/severity ratings. Monitor for tickets without impact classifications, incidents handled in FIFO order rather than risk-based prioritization, or missing fields in incident tracking systems for category and priority metadata.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incidents Not Escalated or Elevated as Needed
signals.canonical_name: Incidents Not Escalated or Elevated as Needed
signals.description: Incidents are not escalated or elevated as needed.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify high-severity incidents that remain at lower response tiers, critical events not reported to management or executive teams, incidents exceeding SLA thresholds without escalation, or missing escalation paths in incident workflows. Monitor for indicators that incident scope or impact has grown but response level has not adjusted accordingly.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Response Plan Not Executed with Third Parties
signals.canonical_name: Incident Response Plan Not Executed with Third Parties
signals.description: The incident response plan is not executed in coordination with relevant third parties.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for incidents where third-party stakeholders (vendors, service providers, law enforcement, regulatory bodies) were not notified or coordinated with during incident response execution. Look for gaps in communication logs, missing escalation records to external parties, or incomplete incident response documentation that should reference third-party coordination activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Criteria for Initiating Incident Recovery Not Applied
signals.canonical_name: Criteria for Initiating Incident Recovery Not Applied
signals.description: Criteria for initiating incident recovery are not applied.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for incidents transitioning to recovery phase without documented criteria being met, premature recovery initiation before containment verification, missing approval checkpoints for recovery operations, or recovery activities starting without validation that threats have been eradicated. Monitor for gaps between incident resolution and formal recovery criteria assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Reports Not Triaged and Validated
signals.canonical_name: Incident Reports Not Triaged and Validated
signals.description: Incident reports are not triaged and validated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incident reports that bypass triage processes or lack validation steps. Monitor for alerts that go directly to investigation without initial assessment, missing triage timestamps, incomplete initial classification fields, or reports lacking analyst validation signatures. Check for backlogs of unreviewed alerts or incidents submitted without proper vetting.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incidents Not Contained
signals.description: Incidents are not contained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incidents where lateral movement continues after detection, malware spreading beyond initially identified systems, ongoing data exfiltration, or active attacker presence without network segmentation or isolation measures. Monitor for missing containment actions such as system quarantine, network disconnection, account disablement, or firewall rule implementation to limit incident scope.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incidents Not Eradicated
signals.description: Incidents are not eradicated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for recurring incidents from the same root cause, persistence mechanisms not removed (backdoors, scheduled tasks, registry modifications), malware remnants or infected files not deleted, compromised credentials still active, or vulnerabilities exploited in the incident remaining unpatched. Monitor for incidents marked resolved without evidence of complete threat removal or system restoration to known-good state.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Critical Objectives for External Stakeholders

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations without regular strategy review processes, lack of metrics to measure strategy effectiveness, absence of governance forums to evaluate cybersecurity outcomes, or failure to use performance data to adjust strategic direction.

signals.canonical_name: Cybersecurity Policy Not Reviewed and Updated

signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations with outdated cybersecurity policies, no documented policy review schedule, policies not updated to reflect current threat landscape or regulatory changes, lack of version control for policy documents, or absence of stakeholder communication when policies are updated.

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of configuration baselines, missing configuration change control processes, untracked system configurations, absence of configuration documentation, and failure to enforce secure configuration standards across platforms.

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for outdated firmware versions, end-of-life hardware still in production, lack of hardware lifecycle management, failure to sanitize hardware before disposal, missing hardware maintenance schedules, and inadequate tracking of hardware assets.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Log Records Not Generated
signals.description: Log records are not generated and made available for continuous monitoring.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for disabled logging services, incomplete audit trails, insufficient log retention, lack of log aggregation mechanisms, missing security event logging, and failure to make logs accessible for monitoring and analysis.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Secure Development Practices Not Integrated
signals.description: Secure software development practices are not integrated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of security requirements in development, missing secure coding standards, absence of code review processes, inadequate security testing, failure to track security metrics in SDLC, and missing security training for developers.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Software Not Properly Maintained
signals.description: Software is not maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for outdated software versions, missing security patches, unsupported software still in use, lack of software lifecycle management, failure to remove deprecated applications, and inadequate vulnerability remediation processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Unauthorized Software Not Prevented
signals.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are not prevented.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of application whitelisting, missing software restriction policies, absence of code signing enforcement, uncontrolled software installations, failure to prevent unauthorized executables, and inadequate application control mechanisms.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Change Management Risk Assessment
signals.description: Changes and exceptions are not managed, assessed for risk impact, and tracked.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that change management processes do not include risk assessment steps, or that policy exceptions and deviations are not evaluated for risk impact. Organizations should integrate risk assessment into change management workflows and establish exception tracking and review processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Hardware and Software Integrity Assessment
signals.canonical_name: No Hardware and Software Integrity Assessment
signals.description: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are not assessed prior to acquisition.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that supply chain risk assessment processes for hardware and software are not in place. Organizations should implement verification procedures including cryptographic hash validation, digital signature verification, trusted supplier validation, and supply chain provenance checks before deploying new technology assets.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Impact and Likelihood Assessment
signals.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are not identified.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that risk analysis processes combining threat, vulnerability, impact, and likelihood assessments are not being performed. Organizations should implement risk assessment methodologies that evaluate the potential business and operational impacts of threats exploiting known vulnerabilities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Risk Response Management
signals.description: Risk responses are not chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that risk treatment processes (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid) are not documented, tracked, or communicated to stakeholders. Organizations should implement risk response planning, tracking systems, and communication protocols to ensure identified risks are addressed systematically.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Risk Understanding
signals.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are not used to understand inherent risk.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that the organization is not synthesizing threat, vulnerability, and impact data to calculate inherent risk or prioritize risk responses. Organizations should implement risk calculation and prioritization frameworks that combine these elements to inform decision-making and resource allocation.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Supplier Assessment
signals.description: Critical suppliers are not assessed prior to acquisition.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that third-party and supplier risk assessment processes are not performed before establishing critical vendor relationships. Organizations should implement vendor risk assessment programs that evaluate supplier security posture, compliance status, and risk management capabilities prior to procurement decisions.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Threat Identification
signals.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are not identified and recorded.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that threat identification processes are not established or maintained. Organizations should implement threat modeling, threat intelligence analysis, and threat documentation processes to identify both external threat actors and internal threat scenarios relevant to their environment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Threat Intelligence
signals.description: Cyber threat intelligence is not received from information sharing forums and sources.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that the organization is not participating in or receiving threat intelligence from industry information sharing and analysis centers (ISACs), threat intelligence platforms, or other threat data sources. Organizations should establish relationships with relevant threat intelligence communities and implement processes to consume and act on threat intelligence.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Vulnerability Disclosure Process
signals.description: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are not established.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that the organization lacks a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program or security contact mechanism for external researchers to report security issues. Organizations should establish vulnerability disclosure policies, secure reporting channels (e.g., security.txt, bug bounty programs), and response procedures.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Vulnerability Identification
signals.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are not identified, validated, and recorded.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that vulnerability scanning, validation, and documentation processes are not in place or functioning. Organizations should implement vulnerability assessment programs including automated scanning, manual testing, and vulnerability tracking systems.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Public Updates on Incident Recovery Not Shared Using Approved Methods
signals.canonical_name: Public Updates on Incident Recovery Not Shared Using Approved Methods
signals.description: Public updates on incident recovery are not shared using approved methods.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify public-facing incidents where recovery communications bypass approved channels, lack pre-authorization, or use inconsistent messaging. Monitor for unauthorized social media posts, unapproved press releases, or communications that deviate from established crisis communication protocols.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Recovery Activities and Progress Not Communicated to Stakeholders
signals.canonical_name: Recovery Activities and Progress Not Communicated to Stakeholders
signals.description: Recovery activities and progress are not communicated to stakeholders.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for recovery operations conducted without stakeholder status updates, progress reports, or communication plans. Look for gaps in internal notifications to leadership, external updates to partners/customers, or regulatory reporting during recovery phases.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.canonical_name: No Integration with Enterprise Risk Management
signals.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities are not integrated into enterprise risk management.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for siloed cybersecurity risk management, absence of cybersecurity risks in enterprise risk registers, missing integration between cybersecurity and ERM teams, lack of unified risk reporting.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Risk Appetite and Tolerance Statements
signals.canonical_name: No Risk Appetite and Tolerance Statements
signals.description: Risk appetite and tolerance statements are not established, communicated, and maintained.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of risk appetite statements, undefined risk tolerance levels, missing communication channels for risk thresholds, lack of risk acceptance criteria.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Standardized Risk Management Method
signals.description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, and tracking risks is not established.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for inconsistent risk calculation methodologies, absence of risk scoring frameworks, missing risk categorization schemas, lack of standardized risk documentation templates, undefined prioritization criteria.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Risk Management Objectives
signals.description: Risk management objectives are not established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of documented risk management objectives, missing stakeholder agreement on risk priorities, lack of formal risk appetite statements.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Risk-Informed Strategic Direction
signals.description: Strategic direction is not informed by risk management outcomes.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for strategic plans without risk considerations, missing risk response options, lack of documented risk treatment decisions, absence of risk-based prioritization in strategic initiatives.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Strategic Opportunities in Risk Discussions
signals.canonical_name: No Strategic Opportunities in Risk Discussions
signals.description: Strategic opportunities are not characterized and included in risk discussions.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for risk discussions focused only on negative outcomes, absence of opportunity identification in risk assessments, missing consideration of competitive advantages from security investments, lack of positive risk evaluation frameworks.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Supply Chain Risk Communication Lines
signals.canonical_name: No Supply Chain Risk Communication Lines
signals.description: Lines of communication for cybersecurity risks across the supply chain are not established.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing vendor risk communication processes, absence of third-party risk escalation paths, lack of supply chain risk reporting mechanisms, undefined communication channels for supplier security incidents.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Backup and Restoration Asset Integrity Not Verified Before Use
signals.canonical_name: Backup and Restoration Asset Integrity Not Verified Before Use
signals.description: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is not verified before use.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for backup restorations that occur without hash verification, signature validation, or integrity checks. Look for missing pre-restoration testing procedures or skipped verification steps during recovery operations that could introduce compromised data.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Critical Functions and Risk Not Considered for Post-Incident Norms
signals.canonical_name: Critical Functions and Risk Not Considered for Post-Incident Norms
signals.description: Critical mission functions and risk management are not considered to establish post-incident operational norms.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify recovery scenarios where operations resume without risk assessment updates or critical function reviews. Monitor for missing post-incident evaluations of acceptable risk levels, residual vulnerabilities, or changes to operational baselines following significant incidents.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Recovery Actions Not Selected, Scoped, Prioritized, and Performed
signals.canonical_name: Recovery Actions Not Selected, Scoped, Prioritized, and Performed
signals.description: Recovery actions are not selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify recovery efforts that lack documented selection criteria, scope definition, or prioritization frameworks. Monitor for random or reactive recovery actions without clear business impact analysis or sequencing based on critical function dependencies.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Recovery End Not Declared Based on Criteria
signals.canonical_name: Incident Recovery End Not Declared Based on Criteria
signals.description: The end of incident recovery is not declared based on criteria.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incidents where recovery activities cease without formal closure declaration or documented completion criteria. Monitor for missing post-recovery documentation, lessons learned, or undefined exit criteria that leave recovery status ambiguous.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Incident Recovery Plan Not Executed
signals.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is not executed.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for incidents where the recovery phase is triggered but no documented recovery plan execution occurs, or when recovery activities proceed ad-hoc without following established procedures. Look for gaps between incident detection/containment and formal recovery initiation.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Restored Asset Integrity Not Verified and Normal Status Not Confirmed
signals.canonical_name: Restored Asset Integrity Not Verified and Normal Status Not Confirmed
signals.description: The integrity of restored assets is not verified and normal operating status not confirmed.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for systems returned to production without post-restoration integrity checks, functionality testing, or formal operational status confirmation. Look for missing validation steps that confirm restored assets are clean, functional, and operating within normal parameters.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Inadequate Resources Allocated for Cybersecurity
signals.description: Adequate resources for cybersecurity implementation are not allocated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations with insufficient cybersecurity budget allocations, understaffed security teams relative to organizational size and risk profile, lack of necessary security tools and technologies, or documented resource constraints preventing implementation of security controls.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Leadership Accountability for Cybersecurity Risk
signals.canonical_name: No Leadership Accountability for Cybersecurity Risk
signals.description: Organizational leadership is not accountable for cybersecurity risk.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations where executive leadership has not formally accepted accountability for cybersecurity risk management, lacks documented cybersecurity responsibilities in role descriptions, or does not demonstrate active engagement in cybersecurity governance activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Cybersecurity Not Included in Human Resources Practices
signals.canonical_name: Cybersecurity Not Included in Human Resources Practices
signals.description: Cybersecurity is not included in human resources practices.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations where cybersecurity is not integrated into hiring processes, job descriptions lack cybersecurity responsibilities, performance reviews do not include security metrics, onboarding/offboarding procedures lack security components, or security awareness training is not mandatory for all personnel.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities Not Defined
signals.canonical_name: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities Not Defined
signals.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities for cybersecurity are not established and communicated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations lacking documented cybersecurity roles and responsibilities, absence of RACI matrices or equivalent documentation, unclear authority delegation for security decisions, or evidence that personnel are unaware of their cybersecurity obligations.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Suppliers Not Included in Incident Planning and Response
signals.canonical_name: Suppliers Not Included in Incident Planning and Response
signals.description: Relevant suppliers and third parties are not included in cybersecurity exercises.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of supplier involvement in incident planning, response exercises, and recovery activities. Check for lack of coordination mechanisms or communication channels with critical suppliers during incident scenarios.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Due Diligence on Prospective Suppliers
signals.canonical_name: No Due Diligence on Prospective Suppliers
signals.description: Due diligence is not performed on prospective suppliers.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of pre-contract due diligence processes for suppliers and third parties. Check for lack of planning activities or risk assessments conducted before establishing formal supplier relationships.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Post-Acquisition Supply Chain Risk Management Plans
signals.canonical_name: No Post-Acquisition Supply Chain Risk Management Plans

signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of provisions in SCRM plans for post-contract or post-partnership activities. Check for lack of processes to handle data return, asset recovery, or ongoing obligations after supplier relationships end.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Integration of Supply Chain Risk Management into Cybersecurity and Enterprise Risk Management
signals.canonical_name: No Integration of Supply Chain Risk Management into Cybersecurity and Enterprise Risk Management

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of integration between supply chain risk management and broader cybersecurity or enterprise risk management programs. Check for lack of inclusion in risk assessment processes and continuous improvement activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Supply Chain Security Practices Not Integrated into Acquisitions
signals.canonical_name: Supply Chain Security Practices Not Integrated into Acquisitions

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of supply chain security practices in acquisition processes and lifecycle management. Check for lack of performance monitoring of security practices throughout the technology product and service lifecycle.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Program
signals.canonical_name: No Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Program
signals.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program and strategy are not established.

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of documented supply chain risk management programs, strategies, objectives, policies, or processes. Check for lack of stakeholder agreement or formal approval of SCRM initiatives.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities for Suppliers
signals.canonical_name: No Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities for Suppliers
signals.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers are not established.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of defined cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners. Check for lack of communication or coordination mechanisms for these roles across internal and external stakeholders.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Suppliers Not Known and Prioritized by Criticality
signals.canonical_name: Suppliers Not Known and Prioritized by Criticality
signals.description: Suppliers are not known and prioritized by criticality.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of a complete supplier inventory or lack of criticality classification for suppliers. Check for missing documentation of critical vs. non-critical suppliers or absence of prioritization mechanisms.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: No Cybersecurity Requirements in Supply Chain Contracts
signals.canonical_name: No Cybersecurity Requirements in Supply Chain Contracts
signals.description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are not established and communicated.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of cybersecurity requirements in supplier contracts and agreements. Check for lack of prioritization of security requirements or missing integration of cybersecurity clauses in third-party agreements.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls

signals.name: Supplier Risks Not Understood and Managed
signals.canonical_name: Supplier Risks Not Understood and Managed
signals.description: Risks posed by a supplier or other third party are not understood and managed.
signals.applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of ongoing risk management activities for suppliers throughout the relationship lifecycle. Check for lack of documentation, prioritization, assessment, response, or monitoring of supplier-related risks.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
